title: Should I pay off my car loan early or build an emergency fund first?
post: I'm 24 and just started my first full-time job. I have a car loan with about $6,000 left at 5% interest and only $800 in savings. My parents say I should throw every spare dollar at the loan, but my coworker says I should get three months of expenses saved first. My rent and bills are about $1,400 a month and I can put roughly $700 a month toward one or the other. Which one makes more sense?

title: My [27F] best friend [28F] keeps cancelling plans last minute
post: We've been friends since college. In the last two months she has cancelled on me five times, usually an hour before we're supposed to meet, and always with a vague excuse. When I brought it up she said I was being dramatic. I miss her but I'm starting to feel like I'm the only one trying. Should I keep reaching out or give her space?

title: Landlord kept my whole deposit for 'cleaning' after I moved out
post: I rented an apartment for two years and left it spotless. I took photos and video on move-out day. Three weeks later the landlord emailed saying he is keeping my entire $1,200 deposit for professional cleaning and repainting, with no receipts. The lease says normal wear and tear is not deductible. What are my options?
